title: Another thought
note: The prompt leaves and a different one rises in its place. There is no limit and nothing is counted.
text: Asha · 7 months Good morning, Mama. Describe Asha's face at the end of peekaboo. Another thought Saturday 0:31 Asha, um, today you you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too. Read it back Speak Type Not much today Tonight Book Family
lines: Describe Asha's face at the end of peekaboo.
Asha, um, today you you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too.
